## What are the benefits of renting a storage space? More room at home, safer belongings, less stress while moving, and no need for a bigger flat. Simple guide.


There are many advantages to using a storage space. You get more space at home. Your belongings are safer. You experience less stress during move-outs and renovations. With storage space, you are able to keep belongings you may need later without having to move to a larger home. You are only charged for storing the belongings you want to keep. You are able to retrieve the belongings at a later time. With[StowNest](https://stownest.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+space+for+rent) , you are also able to use a pickup and delivery service so you don't have to move the items yourself.


Now, lets look at the different advantages and see if renting a storage space is a good option for you.


## **Storage spaces provide more space at home without the hassle of a move**


With so many belongings, over the years, rooms in a typical Indian household collect so many extra things like old clothes, additional furniture, boxes of stuff, mattresses, appliances you rarely use, etc. A storage space provides you with the opportunity to get these things out of your house and stop having to live with them. Usually, this is a lot less stressful than having to move to a larger house.


## **Your things aren't safe in a crowded corner**


Things that are stored in a balcony, loft or other spare room are exposed to the risk of being damaged by pests, dust and damp, or just being bumped around. The right storage system keeps your belongings in a controlled environment.


At StowNest, the warehouse has 24/7 CCTV, and Pest control every 7-10 days. Items are also insured up to 2.5 lakh rupees against theft, fire and natural disasters.


Whichever storage system you choose, make sure you understand the security and insurance policies before you make a decision. Security and insurance are more important than the look of the facility.


## **Storage makes moving easier**


Moving is no easy task and things rarely go according to plan. The old flat needs to be vacated on a certain date and the new one is ready on another. Where do your belongings go in the interim?


You can store your belongings and finish what you need to do and retrieve them when your new home is ready. In the interim, you won’t have to rush or pile everything in a friend’s house.


StowNest also provides other moving related services such as packers and movers in seven cities (Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi ,Kolkata, coimbatore ). This service can be used in addition to storage or on its own.


## **Storage makes renovations and painting easier**


When your house is under renovation or painting, furniture is in the way. Storage space gives you the option to keep your furniture safe until the work is completed.


## **You can keep things without paying for a larger home**


A bigger home costs more in rent. With storage, you can keep items that you don't need in your home outside, and keep your home the size you need.


At StowNest, price depends on how many items you store, and not on the size of the space. Customer support provides a quote based on your item list, and this can work for a household that needs to store a few items.


## **It works for short and long needs**


Storage can be short term. People often use storage while they are in the process of moving, or while their home is being renovated. People also use storage to keep seasonal items.


You can keep heirlooms and other items that you don't need all the time. The great thing about storage is that you choose how long you want it.


Before you book, ask the company how their billing works, so you know what to expect.


## **You don’t have to carry or transport anything**


With[pickup and delivery storage](https://stownest.com/self-storage?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+space+for+rent) , the team does the carrying for you. You don't need to arrange transport, helpers or make several trips yourself. When you want your items back, you just make a request for delivery.


This is very convenient for people with bulky furniture, or if you are really busy and your residence is on a higher floor.


## **You always know where your stuff is**


Losing track of your stuff is a real concern with storage. At StowNest, every single thing you put in storage is scanned with a barcode. You can view pictures and videos of your items through the StowNest app. You can check your stuff any time without having to go to the warehouse.


If you want to physically go to the warehouse, you can make an appointment in advance with customer support. There are no walk-in visits.


## **Damage is covered**


Stuff can get damaged when mishandled. A good storage service has processes in place. StowNest has a process whereby they repair or replace stuff that has been damaged physically while in their care, storage or transit. Make sure you verify this process with your storage provider before deciding on them.


## **You can store sentimental things you can't get rid of**


Old trunks, brass items, wedding sarees, photo frames, furniture. Many things have memories, and they don’t fit in a smaller home. With storage, you can keep them safely, without feeling you need to sell or throw them away.


## **Who benefits most from renting a storage space?**


-


People who are in the process of moving house.


-


Families who are renovating or repainting their home.


-


People who are moving to a smaller flat.


-


People who are working or studying away from home for a few months.


-


Families who have a lot of festival or seasonal items.


-


Owners who are clearing their flat before selling it.


-


Owners who are clearing their flat before renting it.


[StowNest's self storage](https://stownest.com/?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+space+for+rent) is only for household items. Business stock and commercial goods are not included in this service.


## **Things to Check Before You Rent**


Benefits only count if the basics are right. Before you book, make sure to ask:


-


How is the price worked out? By space or by items?


-


What are the security and insurance details?


-


How are my items tracked?


-


How will I get them back? and with how much notice?


-


What happens if something is damaged?


-


What is not allowed to be stored?


For a full checklist, read our guide on storage space for rent for your home items. You can also view the entire StowNest Self Storage offering.


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**1. What are the pros of renting a storage space?**


Most importantly, you get more space at home. Also, your belongings are safer, especially if you are moving or doing renovations. You won’t need to rent a bigger house, too. If you use pickup and delivery storage, you don’t even have to carry your things yourself.


**2. Is it worth renting a storage space?**


Yes, if you only need space for a while and want to keep belongings that you can’t fit at home. It doesn’t make sense to rent a storage space if you want to keep belongings you’ll never use, as you should donate or sell them instead.


**3. Should I opt for a self storage space or bigger house?**


You should definitely opt for a[self storage space](https://stownest.com/self-storage?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=website&utm_campaign=storage+space+for+rent) . Renting a bigger house means you have higher monthly rent, and you might even barely use some of the rooms. Storage only charges you for the space you use. Plus, at StowNest, customers get support to get a quote for pricing.


**4. Will my things be safe in a storage space?**


Not all providers have good security, so be sure to ask. At StowNest, the warehouse is 24/7 monitored by CCTV, and pest control is done every 7 to 10 days. Stored items are also insured for up to ₹2.5 lakhs against theft, fire and natural disasters.


**5. What are the benefits of using storage during a house shift?**


You store your things in the gap of time when you leave your old home and before you can move into your new one. This way your things are safe, and you don’t have to rush to get them at the last minute.


**6. Can I use storage for a short time only?**


Yes, Many people rent storage for a few weeks or months. Some providers may charge more if you don't rent for a full month. Make sure to check the billing policy before renting.


**7. Do I have to take my items to a storage facility?**


Not if you use a service like StowNest. StowNest picks up your items and delivers them back when you're ready for them.


**8. How do I check my items if they are stored?**


All StowNest items are barcode tracked. You can view photos and videos of your items once it's stored in a warehouse . A visit to the warehouse can be arranged through customer support.


**9. What if my items get damaged during storage?**


StowNest replaces or repairs the items that were damaged during storage or transport at no cost to you.
